novel_features.name: Failure triage
novel_features.description: See what broke recently, grouped by workflow and failing node, with the latest execution to retry.
novel_features.rationale: Groups synced error executions with cached failing-node detail; the API only returns a flat paginated list.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this first when asked what is failing in n8n instead of paging through executions one by one. Reads the synced mirror: run `n8n-pp-cli sync --resources workflows,executions,credentials` first.

novel_features.name: Find usages
novel_features.description: Find every workflow and node that uses a credential, node type, webhook path, variable, or sub-workflow.
novel_features.rationale: Queries a local table of every node across all synced workflows; no API endpoint answers cross-workflow references.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before rotating a credential, retiring a webhook, or editing a shared sub-workflow to know the blast radius. Reads the synced mirror: run `n8n-pp-cli sync --resources workflows,executions,credentials` first.

novel_features.name: Stale and unprotected workflows
novel_features.description: Find active workflows with no recent successful run, workflows that never ran, and active workflows without an error workflow.
novel_features.rationale: Joins synced workflows against their latest successful execution locally.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for hygiene sweeps to catch silently dead automations. Reads the synced mirror: run `n8n-pp-cli sync --resources workflows,executions,credentials` first.

novel_features.name: Wait for execution
novel_features.description: Block until an execution finishes and exit non-zero if it failed, with the failing node and message.
novel_features.rationale: Polls with backoff and maps execution status to exit codes for scripts and agents.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use in an edit-then-test loop to branch on whether the run passed without writing a polling script.

novel_features.name: Semantic workflow diff
novel_features.description: Compare a workflow across two instances or two saved versions at the node and connection level, ignoring layout noise.
novel_features.rationale: Understands n8n's nodes and connections graph and filters positions, ids, and timestamps.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before promoting dev to prod or after an edit to see exactly which nodes changed.

novel_features.name: Credential audit
novel_features.description: List unused credentials, credentials many workflows depend on, and workflow references to credentials that no longer exist.
novel_features.rationale: Anti-joins synced credentials against every node's credential references locally; secrets are never read.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before credential rotation or client handoff cleanup. Reads the synced mirror: run `n8n-pp-cli sync --resources workflows,executions,credentials` first.

narrative.headline: Every n8n Public API endpoint, plus a local mirror that answers what is failing, what uses what, and what changed.
narrative.value_prop: Manage workflows, executions, credentials, data tables, projects, and more on any self-hosted or cloud n8n instance. Sync once and get offline search, failure triage with 'executions failures', cross-workflow usage lookups with 'workflows uses', and node-level diffs between instances with 'workflows diff'.
narrative.auth_narrative: Create an API key in n8n under Settings > n8n API, then export N8N_API_KEY. Point at your instance with N8N_URL=https://n8n.example.com (the same variable the official n8n CLI uses; /api/v1 is appended) or N8N_BASE_URL=https://n8n.example.com/api/v1. The default is http://localhost:5678/api/v1. The public API must be enabled on the instance, and some resources (projects, variables, source control, SSO, LDAP, log streaming, promotions) need an n8n license.

quickstart.comment: Check configuration without touching the network
Confirm the API key works and see your workflows
Build the local mirror the cross-workflow commands read from
See what broke recently, grouped by workflow and node

troubleshoots.fix: Set N8N_API_KEY to a key from Settings > n8n API on the same instance as N8N_BASE_URL
N8N_BASE_URL must end in /api/v1 (for example https://n8n.example.com/api/v1); or set N8N_URL to the bare instance root and /api/v1 is added for you
That resource needs an n8n Enterprise or Pro license; use the community-edition resources instead

troubleshoots.symptom: workflows uses, workflows stale, credentials usage, or executions failures returns nothing

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to operate an n8n instance from a terminal or agent: list and edit workflows, triage failed executions, find which workflows use a credential or node, compare workflows between instances, and manage data tables, tags, variables, and projects through the public API.
anti_triggers: Designing new workflows from scratch with node documentation lookup; use n8n-mcp or the n8n editor
Instance administration that needs the server shell (database backups, encryption keys, n8n export:credentials --decrypted)
Reading credential secret values; the public API never returns them
